title: Comfort Food: Cheesy Veggie Dosa-dillas
subtitle: with Pico de Gallo
description: Whether you're full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they're packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they're totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Cook potato: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Peel the potato and cut into 1cm chunks. Put the potato in a small saucepan of cold salted water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook for 8-9 mins until tender. Drain.

Make pico de gallo: Meanwhile, finely chop the tomatoes and onion. Finely chop the coriander, including the stems. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Coarsely grate the cheese. Combine the tomato, coriander and half the onion in a bowl. Add 2 tsp red wine vinegar, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine.

Cook dosa filling: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over medium heat. Cook the remaining onion, stirring, for 3-4 mins until softened. Add the garlic and masala seasoning and cook, stirring, for 1-2 mins until fragrant. Add the potato and gently stir to combine. Remove the pan from the heat. Season with salt and pepper.

Assemble and bake: Divide the dosa filling among the tortillas, then scatter over the cheese and half the pico de gallo. Fold the tortillas over to enclose the filling, then press together firmly. Put the dosa-dillas on the lined tray and lightly spray or brush with olive oil. Bake for 10-12 mins until golden and crisp.
Serve up: Divide the dosa-dillas and remaining pico de gallo among plates. Serve with the mayonnaise, if desired, for dipping. Enjoy!

Did you know?: What do you get when you cross the Indian dosa and Mexican quesadilla? The dosa-dilla! Swap the usual dosa crepes, which are made from a fermented lentil and rice batter, for tortillas. Fill them with a dosa-style filling (we've opted for spiced potato and onion), then fold over and bake like quesadillas.
